question: Which of the following cities hosted the European Political Community Summit in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is option 3,

The correct answer is __**Budapest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The European Political Community (EPC) Summit in November 2024 was hosted by **Budapest, Hungary**.
 
• The EPC is a platform aimed at fostering political dialogue and cooperation among European countries, including non-EU members.
 
• Budapest was chosen to underscore Hungary's geopolitical significance in Central Europe and its role in fostering regional cooperation.
 
• This summit brought together leaders from over 40 countries to discuss pressing issues like energy security, climate change, and European stability.
 
• The event marked significant strides towards deeper collaboration among European nations amidst global challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **European Political Community (EPC)**

 
 
• It is an intergovernmental forum launched in 2022 to strengthen political and strategic dialogue across Europe.
 
• The EPC includes both EU and non-EU countries, highlighting its inclusive approach.
 
• Its primary focus lies on addressing shared challenges like energy, security, and economic resilience.
 
 
 
• **Hungary's Role in Europe**
 
 
• Hungary is strategically located in Central Europe, making it a key player in regional connectivity and cooperation.
 
• Budapest has historically hosted several high-profile international summits and forums.
 
 
 
• **Energy Security in Europe**
 
 
• Energy security was a major agenda point during the summit due to the ongoing energy crisis in Europe.
 
• Efforts were made to discuss sustainable energy solutions and reduce dependency on external sources.
 
 
 
• **Climate Change Discussions**
 
 
• The summit also emphasized collaborative efforts to tackle climate change through innovation and global partnerships.
 
• European nations aimed to implement greener policies and enhance carbon neutrality goals.
